items.summary: Backup and DRFeatureYou can now edit existing backup plans for Cloud SQL instances to updatesettings such as backup rules and maximum custom on-demand retention periods.To learn more, seeBack up Cloud SQL instances to a backup vault.BigtableFeatureYou can use Knowledge Catalog to discover authorized views, logical views, andcontinuous materialized views. This integration lets you search for thesegranular data assets alongside your Bigtable instances and tables. Thisfeature isgenerally available (GA).For more information, seeManage data assets using Knowledge Catalog.DatastreamFeatureDatastream integration with Knowledge Catalog is nowgenerally available(GA). For moreinformation, seethe documentation.SAP on Google CloudAnnouncementGoogle SecOps for SAP is generally available (GA)Google SecOps for SAP is generally available (GA). This solutionhelps you protect your enterprise SAP applications by integratingbusiness-critical telemetry into Google SecOps to provideunified visibility, threat detection, and security response capabilities.This release includes:Log ingestion from SAP RISE and self-managed SAP environments that run onGoogle Cloud, on-premises, or other clouds.SAP-specific YARA-L threat detection rules available in the Google SecOpsDetection Rules GitHub repository.Automated threat response and containment capabilities by using the SAP RFCGateway and SOAR playbooks(Preview).For more information, seeSecure SAP applications with Google SecOps.
